GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (29 Dec 45) CCS
(SCAPIN - 514)
29 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Disposition of Frequency for Wireless Communications Circuit.
1. Reference is made to letter file S523 dated 20 December 1945 from the Liaison Commission for the Imperial Japanese Demobilization Committees, subject as above.
2. The frequency of 3950 kc/s may be used at Hiroshima Signal Office provided no interference to other radio services is caused. The maximum power to be used will not exceed 250 watts to avoid interference to other stations operating on the same frequency.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
